nodes.label: Scenario 1 — Sun position and day summary are correct
nodes.rationale: Unit tests compare ported NOAA implementation against reference values at fixed locations (Quito, Dubai, London, Tromsø, Ushuaia).

nodes.label: Scenario 2 — Shadows fall correctly
nodes.rationale: Asserts sun's ENU unit vector and shadow direction; verifies ShadowMaterial ground plane extent vs shadow camera frustum.

nodes.label: Scenario 3 — Buildings retrieved through the platform
nodes.rationale: Expects provider to parse Overpass responses, handle height provenance (known/assumed), and manage count caps.

nodes.label: Scenario 6 — Teardown leaves nothing behind
nodes.rationale: Asserts scene child count, shadowMap state, and resource disposal after 50 activate/deactivate cycles.

nodes.label: Scenario 11 — SC-009: no framework change was needed
nodes.rationale: Validates that the feature was built without modifying the core viewer/extension/panel frameworks, identifying findings where this failed.
